testsuite.name: gspa.integration.prior.CoherencePriorModuleSpec

testcase.name: an activated, half-complete module gets its evidenced step rescued and pinned; the operon partner wins
a module activated by a shared enzyme alone, or below half complete, is not refined
steps without any candidate stay open: no claim is invented
legacy pathway mode ignores the module definitions
